notes.title: Demo coming soon!!
notes.notes: [p]🚀 Hey everyone! After months in the lab (almost literally), our sci-fi action game is taking shape. You’ll step into the boots of a cowboy abducted into an alien Starship, armed with a living weapon fused to your arm. The demo is coming later this year... so in the meantime, hitting [b]Wishlist[/b] helps us massively and lets you be the first to know when we drop updates. Thanks for riding with us 🤠🔫✨[/p]
